data.body: Task #180 (id 52000780977) ComfyUI integration: NOT complete. Verified: capability-host `src/comfyui.rs` (bounded HTTP client, endpoint validation, API-workflow inspection; 6 tests pass) and desktop `runtime/comfyui/*` + `runtime/service/comfyui.rs` + the `comfyui` Settings section (`cargo check --lib --bins` clean; 25 tests pass). Advanced Python bridge: `python test_bridge.py` passes. Outstanding: the TypeScript ComfyUI Settings panel is implemented by delegation but its vitest run was not verified here. Rust test binaries need `set TMP=C:\Users\timo\AppData\Local\Temp` (and TEMP) or the MSVC linker fails with LNK1104 on C:\WINDOWS. Reference-plugin assertion in tool_registry/tests.rs now expects 5 seed tools. Design: markdown aworkit.capability_host.comfyui_integration.
